info.title: gscript 3.0.2 - self-healing, cross-platform git-push + dev-ops ceremony
info.description: Self-healing, cross-platform git-push + dev-ops ceremony tool. Content-shape preflight gates (trailing-null, file-size, structured-file parse, markdown shrinkage, leak-check), localmd PAT auth, stale-lock recovery, retry-on-collision, per-step CI watch, post-deploy probes. The C# successor to the gscript PowerShell module.

options.name: --hub
options.description:
ANCHOR plane — decides which dir owns im.json and the localmd/ root
(default: CLAUDE.md beside gscript.json's localmdPath).
It anchors; im.json's "hubs" declares the full set.

options.name: --budget
options.description:
line budget — applies ONLY when no im.json declares a plane set;
a declared plane always uses its own budget (default 450)

options.name: --warn-pct
options.description: warn when usage reaches N% of budget (default 90)

options.name: --archived-root
options.description:
pre-relocation root to warn on (repeatable; also im.json archivedRoots)
im.json foreignRoots = roots owned by ANOTHER BODY: absent from this
disk BY DESIGN, so a reference resolves instead of erroring

options.name: --deep
options.description: also stale-path-scan localmd/*.md beside the primary plane

options.name: --strict
options.description: UNRESOLVED paths become errors (allowlist polarity: refuse by default)

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
list unresolved and uncheckable paths
MULTIPLE PLANES: <hubDir>\im.json { "hubs": [ { path, budget, label }, ... ] }.
Paths are relative to the primary plane's directory; each carries its OWN budget.
im.json is operator data — a memory layout is not something a public tree should hold.
UNRESOLVED vs UNCHECKABLE: unresolved = the text names something this linter cannot
place (fatal under --strict). Uncheckable = the linter cannot stat it from this host
(never fatal — a capability limit is not a content defect, and conflating them just
teaches people to drop --strict).
lint exits 1 on any error (budget overrun, stale C:\work path, broken `localmd/…` ref)
so it can gate a ceremony; archived-location references are warnings only.
